title: BRIDLE: Generalized Self-supervised Learning with Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2502.02118v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-supervised learning has been a powerful approach for learning meaningful representations from unlabeled data across various domains, reducing the reliance on large labeled datasets. Inspired by BERT's success in capturing deep bidirectional contexts in natural language processing, similar frameworks have been adapted to other modalities such as audio, with models like BEATs extending the bidirectional training paradigm to audio signals using vector quantization (VQ). However, these frameworks face challenges, notably their dependence on a single codebook for quantization, which may not capture the complex, multifaceted nature of signals. In addition, inefficiencies in codebook utilization lead to underutilized code vectors. translated_title: BRIDLE：基于量化的广义自监督学习
translated_abstract: 自监督学习已成为从各种领域的无标记数据中学习有意义表示的有效方法，减少了对大型标记数据集的依赖。受BERT在自然语言处理中捕捉深层双向上下文成功的启发，类似框架已被适配到其他模态，如音频，其中BEATs等模型通过向量量化（VQ）将双向训练范式扩展到音频信号。然而，这些框架面临挑战，尤其是它们对单一码本进行量化的依赖，这可能无法捕捉信号的复杂、多方面特性。此外，码本利用效率低下导致码向量未被充分利用。为解决这些限制，我们引入了BRIDLE（双向残差量化交错离散学习编码器），一种自监督编码器预训练框架，该框架结合了残差量化。
tldr: 本文提出了BRIDLE框架，通过引入残差量化替代单一码本，解决了现有自监督学习在量化中的码本利用低效和多模态信号捕捉不足的问题，实现了更广义的预训练。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BRIDLE, a self-supervised pretraining framework that replaces single-codebook quantization with residual quantization, addressing codebook underutilization and limited signal complexity capture for more generalized learning.
